reads: public benchmark receipt from main on worker click
public GitHub commit history for bounded worker refs on worker click
visible_now: recent worker list with evidence-recency light
task/word metrics when receipt exposes them

truth_boundaries: Green means recent durable evidence, never generic ACTIVE/OWNED liveness.
Receipt-authored stage timestamps are diagnostic unless externally corroborated.
Durable window is not pure compute duration.
Browser GitHub/raw reads are prototype-only and should be compiled server-side/publicly for the full implementation.

design: Default surface is compact; long notebook content moved behind Archive accordions.
Six touch views: Ahora, Workers, Capacidad, Experimentos, Guide, Archivo.
Workers older than two hours are hidden by default in an archive disclosure.
Only the first eight recent workers are expanded by default; remaining recent workers are collapsible.
Worker inspector opens as a bottom sheet instead of extending the page vertically.
Human-facing experiment progress is expressed as send/no-send plus one percentage bar.
Guide card publishes latest conclusion, planned improvements, human action and evidence boundary.
Capacity view separates current evidence from unanswered concurrency questions.
Worker profiles are explicitly split for future comparison: TEXT/STRUCTURED, BUILD/CODE, ARTIFACT, VERIFY/BROWSER.

Add a Guide-analysis history so each major Worker Lab conclusion can be opened by timestamp.
Add explicit worker-profile filters and per-profile capacity curves for TEXT/STRUCTURED, BUILD/CODE, ARTIFACT and VERIFY/BROWSER.

telemetry_and_measurement: Increase worker event-stream coverage; current workers do not all emit ROUTED/CLAIM/CLOSE telemetry.
Define cadence-aware recent/warm/stale thresholds instead of fixed prototype thresholds.
Compile external server timestamps for beacon/claim/midpoint/primary/reallocation/close per worker.
Attribute worker commits comprehensively rather than only commits touching bounded known refs.

maxcap_workers: Enforce one worker/launch_nonce → one primary RUN slot after first successful CREATE; quarantine duplicate-primary claims.
Automatically exclude duplicate-primary and cross-slot-contaminated replicas from causal analysis.
Compile next adaptive ceiling-search RUN: 40k/60k/90k/120k ×3 with continuation behavior frozen and primary-only local work.
Escalate geometrically if 120k passes rather than declaring it the maximum.
Confirm first ceiling band with 5 replicas at highest passing and lowest failing tier.
Measure sparse-I/O ceiling runs with external clocks and distinguish workload from transport failure.
primary_chat_and_input: Authenticated private end-to-end ingress bridge still does not exist; composer remains draft-only/fail-closed.
When bridge exists, prove web input → durable private message → Guide/work → mirrored reply end-to-end before calling composer functional.
Keep Primary Chat as primary human interface and Worker Lab secondary technical surface.
ideas_input_chain_separate_boundary: Notes exact-back / semantic_registry reliability remains a separate unresolved boundary.
After Notes reliability: connect the known-good STT baseline to Notes.
Then implement minimal universal input: text/voice → IDEA or ACCION → destination → interpretation preview.
Then connect ACCION → Work Unit/atomic worker flow using measured packets.
worker_inspector_deep_history: Para cada worker, reconstruir de forma compilada y navegable: launch envelope recibido, beacon, slot/job asignado, primer claim durable, contexto/cápsula exacta, plan lock, producción, verificación, RETURN, reallocation, close.
Mostrar qué declaró primero el worker y cuál fue la primera instrucción/packet que recibió, citando la evidencia durable correspondiente.
Mostrar todos los commits atribuibles al worker, no sólo los commits de refs acotados consultados desde el navegador.
Calcular tiempos externos por etapa E0→E9 cuando haya clocks suficientes; UNKNOWN cuando no.
Separar tiempo útil, espera externa, GitHub/tool I/O, retries/polls, persistencia y cierre.
Mostrar tareas completadas, palabras/output útil, artifacts, tests, hard gates, retries, fallos y rework.
Agregar timeline expandible con cada transición durable y links a refs/commits.
Agregar cobertura de medición por campo para no confundir ausencia con cero.
guide_analysis: Agregar nota Guide por worker o por incidente cuando exista análisis durable: conclusión, evidencia, qué cambiaría, qué aprendió y próximo experimento.
Mostrar timestamp/frescura de cada análisis Guide.
Mantener una tarjeta global Guide con última síntesis y plan.
No publicar chain-of-thought privado. Persistir en cambio decision summaries, evidence map, alternativas consideradas a nivel resumido y próximos pasos.
Cuando el humano pida cómo se llegó a una conclusión, producir un resumen razonado seguro a partir de evidencia y decisiones, no transcript interno crudo.
concurrency_and_scale: Medir cuántos workers tienen señal durable reciente sin llamar ACTIVE a estados stale.
Construir curva 1 vs N workers: duración por worker, throughput total, calidad, retries, contaminación y fallos.
Determinar si la degradación individual bajo concurrencia queda compensada por throughput agregado.
Mostrar velocidad por ventana 5/30/60 min y distinguir producción útil de simples eventos.
Medir contention de GitHub/transport y separar slowdown de modelo vs infraestructura.
Derivar recomendación humana simple: mandar N más / no mandar / esperar / reparar bottleneck.
worker_profiles: TEXT/STRUCTURED: redacción, clasificación, extracción, síntesis y transformación.
BUILD/CODE: implementación, integración, debugging y tests.
ARTIFACT: archivos, páginas, paquetes, conversiones y ensamblado.
VERIFY/BROWSER: auditoría, browser checks, evidence maps y acceptance.
Comparar para cada perfil tamaño óptimo de batch, contexto, output, tools, I/O y paralelismo.
No generalizar un único worker ideal hasta medir al menos estos perfiles.
compact_ui_followups: Validar en móvil real que tabs/cards quepan sin scroll molesto.
Si el humano lo prefiere, reducir todavía más el panel Ahora a una sola pantalla sin scroll.
Asegurar que workers >2h estén ocultos por defecto y accesibles en Archivo/details.
Mantener una sola barra principal de acción humana, evitando porcentajes competidores.
Permitir abrir Guide desde la ficha de un worker y, cuando exista, mostrar análisis específico de ese worker.
No volver a convertir Worker Lab en una columna infinita de texto.

next_decision: Esperar feedback visual del humano sobre el dashboard compacto. Si aprueba, mover joins/history/Guide-notes al compilador público existente y profundizar el inspector por worker sin crear nueva autoridad.

goals: Keep the useful human answer above the fold.
Replace long vertical notebook flow with compact touch navigation.
Hide workers older than two hours by default.
Expose Guide opinion separately from raw telemetry.
Show human-facing launch guidance instead of only engineering counters.
prototype_v2.human_status_rule: Show current RUN completion as a simple action: do not launch more / slots still missing / no measurable run.
prototype_v2.worker_visibility_rule: Recent <2h visible; older workers collapsed under historical drawer.
prototype_v2.concurrency_boundary: Current data does not yet isolate 1 vs N concurrent worker slowdown. UI explicitly marks this PENDING rather than inventing a value.
prototype_v2.reasoning_boundary: Hidden model chain-of-thought is not available as an execution artifact. Optimize from durable observable trace (packet, tools/evidence, claims, commits, receipts, waits, outputs) plus explicit published decision summaries.

layout: 🟢 Ahora: acción humana simple, progreso, señal reciente, último movimiento, velocidad, duración, problemas.
👤 Workers: sólo <2h por defecto; recientes extra y viejos detrás de details.
⚡ Capacidad: output/tareas/timing y efecto de concurrencia separado.
🧪 Experimentos: RUN actual, resultado, variantes y próximo experimento.
🧠 Guide: última opinión, plan, acción humana y timestamp.
🗂️ Archivo: reglas, negative knowledge, historia, preguntas, mediciones y pendientes largos.
compact_dashboard.human_feedback_target: Evaluar si este formato compacto/touch reemplaza satisfactoriamente la versión vertical antes de promover más detalle.
